items.title: Gucci Spices Up the Fanny Pack for Today's Stylish Gents
items.summary: Philippine fashion outlet Preview.ph covers Gucci's GucciCore-collection Fanny Pack (sibling to the Starlet bag) as worn by local style figures including Preview Best Dressed honoree Jarren Garcia, with several Thai celebrities also spotted carrying it; a regional styling feature rather than brand-issued press release, signaling organic SEA menswear-media pickup of Demna-era GucciCore pieces.

items.title: Gucci Direct-Operated Retail Falls 9% in Q3 as Kering Extends China Market Adjustment Period to Two Years
items.summary: Trade-press aggregation of Kering Q3 results: Gucci direct retail sales fell 9% comparable and overall Gucci revenue dropped 6% to EUR 1.291 billion; CEO Luca de Meo said Asia-Pacific store networks (including swaths of Southeast/East Asia) have reached saturation, with 40% of Kering's 2026 store-closure target expected to land in Asia and no quarter-by-quarter turnaround expected for 12-24 months; a critical-angle structural story directly bearing on Gucci's SEA retail footprint, admitted despite being slightly outside the tightest freshness band because no closer SEA-specific rewrite of this ongoing story surfaced today.

items.title: Fan account post: Sea Tawinan 'takes Gucci to another level' in GucciCore styling
items.summary: A Thai fan account (jingjing_pov) posted praise for actor/model Sea Tawinan's GucciCore styling, tagging @gucci and #GucciCore; organic celebrity-fan amplification tied to Vogue Thailand's coverage of the same look, read primarily by Thai entertainment-fashion audiences; engagement counts were not visible via public search snippet.

items.title: Fan account notes L'Officiel Hommes Thailand and Esquire Vietnam coverage of Xiao Zhan for Gucci
items.summary: A fan account cross-posts that L'Officiel Hommes Thailand and Esquire Vietnam both carried Gucci global ambassador Xiao Zhan's Milan Primavera show appearance on their Facebook pages, urging followers to like/comment; indicates syndicated ambassador content circulating across Thai and Vietnamese entertainment-fashion media via fan-coordinated engagement rather than organic discussion; engagement counts were not visible via public search snippet.
